notes: v3.0.25 — Day navigation stops guessing. Every strategy that puts athenaOne on a date now reads the schedule header BACK and reports the day athenaOne is actually showing: a pull that landed on the wrong day fails loudly instead of importing it silently, and a day that WAS reached is no longer reported as unreachable. Reading the open chart identity can no longer hang without answering. Two permissions the extension never used (audio capture, offscreen documents) were removed. Requires Chrome 116+.
